title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 5 · Slave pens

sourceRecords.title: 12 · Slave pens · area 5
read: Iron bars divide the chamber into cells. Two armed Redbrands stand guard. A woman and a young woman are confined to one side; a boy is held apart from them.

The bars turn the room into a place of confinement rather than ordinary storage. The doors and the space beside them matter if anyone is to leave in a hurry. You can address whoever is actually present, inspect the locks, or check the surrounding route before promising a way out.

brief: Long stone chamber split into three parts by iron bars: north cell holds one thirteen-year-old human boy; south cell holds his mother and eighteen-year-old sister. Plain gray tunics and iron neck collars; filthy straw floors; hinged cell doors with chains and padlocks. Discarded clothing heap against far wall. TWO human guards wearing scarlet cloaks in the central passage. Respectful depiction, no torture or graphic injuries. No Gundren, no extra captives. Prepared first-entry scene, no implied completed rescue.
